fallbackHint: Something went wrong while the report ran. Run it again. If it fails again, contact support.

RejectedAtIntake.label: The report could not use your documents

NoReadableDocuments.label: The report found nothing to read

InputTooLarge.label: The documents hold too much text for this report

DocumentsNotRead.label: Your documents could not be read just now

ScreeningUnavailable.label: Your documents could not be checked
ScreeningUnavailable.hint: The report did not start, because our document check is not working right now. This is a problem on our side, not with your documents. Try again in a few minutes.

CriticalBlockFailure.label: A step of the report failed
CriticalBlockFailure.hint: The report stopped because one of its steps failed. Run it again. If it fails again, contact support.

ResultsLost.label: Some results were lost
ResultsLost.hint: Part of the results could not be saved, so the report stopped. Run it again.

LifetimeExceeded.label: The report took too long
LifetimeExceeded.hint: It ran past its time limit and was stopped. Run it again.

HostLost.label: The report was interrupted
HostLost.hint: The server running it stopped before the report finished. This is a problem on our side, not with your documents. Run it again.

VerificationGroupShape.label: The report's final checks are set up wrong
VerificationGroupShape.hint: The checks at the end of this report cannot run as they are set up. Ask the person who maintains this report type to fix them.

VerificationUnsatisfiable.label: The report's final checks cannot pass
VerificationUnsatisfiable.hint: The checks at the end of this report ask for something the results can never meet. Ask the person who maintains this report type to fix them.
